messages:
Leah: Quick post-all-hands follow-up -- can we summarize the operational asks coming from customer wins/losses and assign owners? Need clear next steps for sales and product.

Ben_sales: From field: wins = predictable latency + clear pricing + strong SLA. Losses = security requirements (HSM/on-prem), embedding price sensitivity at scale, and slow Dedicated onboarding.

Arjun_eng: Technical callouts: 1) HSM integration has two flavors: BYOK via KMS vs. local HSM appliance. 2) On-prem packaging needs an automated installer and a health-check runbook. 3) For latency guarantees we need better cold-start caching metrics.

Mei_product: Proposed roadmap items: a) Private Deployment Starter Kit (P0) b) HSM/KMS integration + audit export (P1) c) Embedding volume pricing + burst GPU pools (P1). Need impact estimates.

Rosa_revops: I'll draft 1-page sales playbooks for each ask: use case, buying committee, pricing caveat, expected ARR. Can do first pass by Wed.

Ben_sales: Also request a canned email/snippet for SDRs with embedding pricing ballpark and typical onboarding timeline. Sales losing time on first calls.

Mei_product: Agreed. Mei -> Ben: can you share two anonymized loss stories in this thread so eng can scope?

Ben_sales: Paste (anonymized): "medtech co required no internet egress + HSM, 6 month procurement cycle -> deprioritized due to cost". Second: "marketplace startup with 3B embeddings/mo, wanted <$0.0005/vector -> we couldn't meet their econs".

Arjun_eng: Thanks. For the embeddings case, we should evaluate quantized model variants + burst pools. I can kick a perf spike.

Leah: Ownership: Rosa -> sales playbooks, Arjun -> perf spike + runbook for private install, Mei -> roadmap tickets + impact estimates. Can we have initial artifacts in 10 business days?

Rosa_revops: Yes. I'll also include a checklist for procurement asks (SLA, data residency, KMS).

opsbot: Meeting recording and notes: https://redwood.internal/allhands/2385006789 -- transcript + action tracker added.

Ben_sales: Quick ask: can we offer pilot credits or short-term Dedicated trial to de-risk procurement? That's closed a few deals for competitors.

Mei_product: Pilot trial policy sounds useful. I'll draft guardrails (duration, quota, support level) and post to this thread.

Arjun_eng: One more technical note: if we ship private starter kit, include a diagnostics endpoint and a one-command collector to help SRE during P0 installs.

Leah: Great work. Let's reconvene in the next leadership sync with the artifacts. :white_check_mark:
